_comment: Melon Synth community voicebank catalog. Keep this file updated via PR.

voicebanks.name: Kasane Teto CV
voicebanks.author: Teto_family (utaforum)
voicebanks.description: The iconic UTAU mascot. Warm, slightly rough chimera voice. Best for pop, rock, anime-style songs. Standard CV format — easy to use, great for beginners.
voicebanks.install_note: Standard UTAU CV voicebank. Works immediately after download.

voicebanks.name: Utane Uta (Defoko)
voicebanks.author: Ameya/Ayame
voicebanks.description: The default UTAU voice. Clear, neutral tone. Good for learning the workflow — predictable behavior, solid phoneme coverage.
voicebanks.install_note: Bundled with UTAU. If UTAU is installed, Defoko is already on your system.

voicebanks.name: Namine Ritsu KIRE
voicebanks.author: NARU-T
voicebanks.description: Popular free voicebank with a clear, bright feminine voice. KIRE version has a clean, sharp quality. Good for ballads and J-pop.
voicebanks.install_note: Standard CV voicebank. Compatible with OpenUTAU.

voicebanks.name: Kasane Teto CVVC English
voicebanks.author: RubyRedEnder, teto_family
voicebanks.description: English CVVC version of Teto. Uses ARPAbet-based phonemes for English synthesis. Required for singing English lyrics naturally with Teto's voice.
voicebanks.install_note: English CVVC bank. Select the 'English ARPAbet' module in MLC for correct phoneme mapping.

voicebanks.name: Hatsune Miku Append Soft (OpenUTAU port)
voicebanks.author: Crypton Future Media / OpenUTAU port by community
voicebanks.description: Community OpenUTAU port of Miku Append Soft. Breathy, soft texture. Check license before commercial use.

download.note: Available in OpenUTAU's built-in voicebank installer. Open OpenUTAU → Tools → Install Singer.

voicebanks.install_note: Install via OpenUTAU's built-in installer for the cleanest setup.

engines.name: OpenUTAU
engines.description: Open source singing synthesizer. Supports UTAU voicebanks, DiffSinger neural voicebanks, and more. The recommended engine for Melon Synth.
